sentences.text: The name Zulmasuchus translates to 'Zulma Gasparini's crocodile'.
Alfredo Paolillo and Omar Linares formally named this genus in 2007 based on fossils from Early Paleocene rocks of the Santa Lucía Formation in Bolivia.

Taxonomically, Zulmasuchus is placed in the superorder Crocodylomorpha, the unranked superorder Crurotarsi, the clade Mesoeucrocodylia, and the class Sauropsida, specifically within the family Sebecidae.
The genus authority is Paolillo & Linares, 2007, while the species Z. querejazus was originally described by Buffetaut & Marshall in 1991.
